svg.title: Actual AOSP evidence: separate recorded counts
svg.desc: Actual AOSP custom-image r6 proof recorded on 30 October 2026 UTC: 34 of 34 operator checks, 236 of 236 harness observations including repeated case names, and 61 of 61 unique native assertion cases. These evidence layers overlap and must not be summed. Guest SELinux was Enforcing and the three BoundaryLab domains were nonpermissive. The native engine test ran once under permissive platform su.

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: ACTUAL AOSP R6 RECEIPTS · 30 OCT 2026 UTC
Three evidence layers. Three separate counts.
The layers overlap. Their totals must not be added together.
All three BoundaryLab security domains were nonpermissive.
Native assertions ran under platform su, which was permissive.
Source: recorded r6 operator, harness and native JSONL receipts.
